BiblicalUsage: Persecution, the pressure that fell on the church from the day Stephen was killed, scattering believers out of Jerusalem. Paul lists persecutions among the things he takes pleasure in for Christ's sake, and he reminds Timothy of the persecutions he endured at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe persecution does not prove God has left us; it proves we belong to a kingdom the world still resists. Paul was delivered out of them all, and that is the pattern I hold to when pressure comes.
